title: Heavy Rain Advisory for Yilan and Hualien Mountains as Cold Air Arrives
summaryZh: ⚠️ 氣象署對宜花山區發布大雨特報，慎防坍方落石；週五低溫約11度。
summaryHi: ⚠️ यीलान और ह्वालियन के पहाड़ों के लिए भारी बारिश की चेतावनी; भूस्खलन से सावधान, शुक्रवार को तापमान लगभग 11 डिग्री।
summaryEs: ⚠️ Aviso por lluvias intensas en las montañas de Yilan y Hualien; riesgo de deslizamientos y mínimas de unos 11 grados el viernes.
summaryJa: ⚠️ 宜蘭・花蓮の山間部に大雨特報。土砂崩れや落石に注意、金曜朝は約11度まで冷え込む。
summaryKo: ⚠️ 이란·화롄 산간에 호우 특보. 산사태와 낙석에 주의하고 금요일 아침은 약 11도까지 떨어진다.
summaryEn: ⚠️ Heavy rain advisory for the Yilan and Hualien mountains, with landslide risk; lows near 11°C on Friday.
paragraphs: Taiwan's Central Weather Administration issued a heavy rain advisory on Thursday for mountainous parts of Yilan and Hualien counties, as a strengthening northeasterly wind brought wet and much cooler weather to the island.

Forecasters said accumulated rainfall in the affected areas could exceed 200 millimetres within 24 hours, or reach 100 millimetres in as little as three hours. Residents were told to stay alert for sudden downpours, landslides and falling rocks. Anyone planning to drive on mountain roads or go hiking in eastern Taiwan should check road conditions first and consider postponing their trip.
Rain was also forecast on Thursday for northern and eastern Taiwan, the Hengchun Peninsula and mountains in the central and south, with snow possible above 3,500 metres overnight.

Conditions are expected to turn colder and drier on Friday, when some low-lying areas could see early-morning lows of around 11 degrees Celsius. Only isolated showers are likely in the east and on the Hengchun Peninsula.

Temperatures should recover from Saturday to Monday, although mornings will remain chilly, before another weather system brings rain and a fresh drop in temperature from Tuesday. Because this is an advisory rather than a typhoon warning, work and classes are continuing as normal.
Taiwan's weather office gave a heavy rain warning on Thursday. It is for the mountains in Yilan and Hualien.
A lot of rain may fall there. In one day, there may be more than 200 millimetres of rain. Rocks can fall and land can slide down the mountains.
It is also raining in the north and east of Taiwan. There may be snow on very high mountains on Thursday night.
On Friday, it will be cold and dry. In some places, it may be only 11 degrees in the early morning. It will get warmer at the weekend.
Please stay away from mountain roads, rivers and hiking paths during the rain. This is not a typhoon, so schools and offices are open. Wear warm clothes.

有些地方清晨可能只有 11 度。

下雨期間請遠離山路、河流和登山步道。

請穿保暖的衣服。

paragraphs: The Central Weather Administration issued a heavy rain advisory on Thursday for the mountain areas of Yilan and Hualien. It warned that more than 200 millimetres of rain could fall in 24 hours, or 100 millimetres in just three hours.
People living in these areas should watch out for sudden downpours, landslides and falling rocks. Drivers and hikers should avoid mountain roads and trails until the rain stops.
Rain is also expected in northern and eastern Taiwan, the Hengchun Peninsula and the mountains of central and southern Taiwan. Snow may fall on peaks above 3,500 metres on Thursday night.
The rain comes with a stronger northeasterly wind, which is bringing cold air. Temperatures could drop to about 11 degrees in some low-lying areas early on Friday, although Friday will be drier.

It will warm up from Saturday to Monday, but mornings will stay cool. Another weather system is expected on Tuesday, bringing more rain and colder air. This is not a typhoon, so there are no days off from work or school.

週四晚上，3,500 公尺以上的山峰可能會下雪。
這場雨伴隨著增強的東北風，帶來了冷空氣。
週五清晨，部分低窪地區氣溫可能降到約 11 度，不過週五會比較乾燥。
週六到週一氣溫會回升，但早晨仍然涼爽。
另一個天氣系統預計週二到來，帶來更多雨和更冷的空氣。
這不是颱風，所以不會停班停課。

paragraphs: Mountainous areas of Yilan and Hualien are under a heavy rain advisory after the Central Weather Administration warned on Thursday that a strengthening northeasterly flow could unleash intense downpours along Taiwan's eastern ranges.

Accumulated rainfall could top 200 millimetres over 24 hours, or hit 100 millimetres within a three-hour window, according to the agency. Such totals raise the risk of landslides and rockfalls, and residents have been urged to remain vigilant. Motorists heading along mountain routes and hikers bound for eastern trails would be wise to check conditions beforehand or delay their plans.
Elsewhere, showers are forecast across the north and east, the Hengchun Peninsula and the central and southern highlands, with snow possible on summits above 3,500 metres overnight.

Once the rain eases, colder and drier air will settle over the island. Early on Friday, temperatures in some low-lying districts may dip to roughly 11 degrees Celsius, a figure echoed by independent meteorologist Wu Der-rong.

A gradual recovery is expected over the weekend, but another system arriving on Tuesday should bring renewed rain and cooling. As the alert falls well short of a typhoon warning, offices and schools remain open.
sentZh: 中央氣象署週四警告，增強的東北氣流可能在台灣東部山脈帶來劇烈降雨，宜蘭和花蓮山區因此處於大雨特報之下。
據該署表示，24 小時累積雨量可能超過 200 毫米，或在三小時內達到 100 毫米。
這樣的雨量會提高坍方和落石的風險，當局呼籲居民保持警覺。
開車走山區路線的駕駛人和前往東部步道的登山客，最好事先查看狀況或延後計畫。
其他地方，北部和東部、恆春半島及中南部高山預報有陣雨，3,500 公尺以上山頂夜間可能降雪。
雨勢減弱後，更冷、更乾的空氣將籠罩全台。
週五清晨，部分低窪地區氣溫可能降到攝氏 11 度左右，獨立氣象專家吳德榮也給出相同的數字。
預計週末氣溫逐漸回升，但週二來臨的另一個天氣系統將再次帶來降雨與降溫。
由於這次特報遠不及颱風警報的等級，辦公室和學校照常開放。

paragraphs: The Central Weather Administration has placed the mountainous areas of Yilan and Hualien under a heavy rain advisory, as an intensifying northeasterly monsoon delivers both persistent rain and a marked drop in temperature across Taiwan.

Forecasters anticipate that cumulative rainfall in the affected zones may surpass 200 millimetres in a 24-hour period, or 100 millimetres in three hours. Rainfall of this magnitude significantly increases the likelihood of landslides and falling debris on steep slopes, and the authorities have advised residents to exercise caution. Travellers would be well advised to consult official road information before using mountain highways.
Precipitation is also predicted for northern and eastern regions, the Hengchun Peninsula and the central and southern mountains, while snowfall is possible at altitudes exceeding 3,500 metres.

By Friday, conditions are expected to become drier but considerably colder, with minimum temperatures in certain low-lying areas falling to approximately 11 degrees Celsius. A modest recovery is forecast for the weekend, followed by a further spell of rain and cooling from Tuesday onwards.
Since the alert is considerably less severe than a typhoon warning, no closures of workplaces or schools have been announced, but people in exposed areas should monitor updates closely.
sentZh: 中央氣象署對宜蘭和花蓮山區發布大雨特報，增強的東北季風為全台帶來持續降雨與明顯降溫。
預報員預期，受影響地區 24 小時累積雨量可能超過 200 毫米，或三小時內達 100 毫米。
這種規模的降雨會大幅增加陡坡發生坍方和落石的可能性，當局已建議居民提高警覺。
旅客在使用山區公路前，最好先查詢官方路況資訊。
北部和東部地區、恆春半島及中南部山區也預計有降雨，海拔 3,500 公尺以上則可能降雪。
到了週五，天氣預計轉乾但明顯更冷，部分低窪地區最低溫將降至約攝氏 11 度。
預報週末氣溫小幅回升，隨後從週二起將再迎來一段降雨與降溫。
由於這次特報的嚴重程度遠低於颱風警報，目前並未宣布停班停課，但位於易受影響地區的民眾應密切留意最新消息。

overnight.ex: A warning may be issued overnight.

paths.ex: Stay on the paths in the forest.

peaks.ex: Snow covered the peaks this morning.

people.ex: Many people came to the event.

period.ex: There is a two-week trial period for new staff.

example.en: Traffic jams are a persistent problem in the city.
example.zh: 塞車是這座城市長期存在的問題。

note.usage: 常形容問題、疼痛、雨：persistent problem/rain；名詞 persistence。

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर में ट्रैफ़िक जाम एक लगातार बनी रहने वाली समस्या है।

noteEs.exampleTr: Los atascos son un problema persistente en la ciudad.

noteJa.exampleTr: 渋滞はこの街の根強い問題だ。

noteKo.exampleTr: 교통 체증은 이 도시의 고질적인 문제다.

placed.ex: Huge pressure was placed on the nurses.

places.ex: Some places in the city have no trees.

planning.en: deciding how to do things in the future

plans.ex: She plans to study in Dublin.

postponing.ex: They are postponing the wedding until spring.

precipitation.en: rain, snow or hail that falls

note.usage: 氣象正式用語；= rain, snow。

noteJa.exampleTr: 降水は日曜までに弱まる。

predicted.en: said what will happen in the future
predicted.ex: Experts predicted a cold winter this year.

rainfall.en: rain; the amount of rain that falls

raise.ex: The shop will raise its prices next month.

ranges.ex: Driving ranges are popular in Taipei.

rather.ex: Walk rather than drive if you can.

reach.en: to get to a certain level
reach.ex: Prices could reach a new high.

recover.en: to go back to a normal level
recover.ex: Temperatures will recover at the weekend.

recovery.en: a return to a better state
recovery.ex: The economy is in slow recovery.

regions.ex: Some regions are poorer than others.

remain.en: to stay in the same state

renewed.ex: There are fears of renewed flooding.

residents.en: people who live in a place

risk.en: a chance of something bad happening
risk.ex: There is a high risk of flooding.

road.en: a way for cars to travel on

roads.en: ways for cars to drive on
roads.ex: The roads were busy on Friday.

rockfalls.en: rocks falling down a mountain or cliff
rockfalls.ex: Rockfalls closed the road for hours.

rocks.ex: Big rocks blocked the mountain road.

routes.en: ways from one place to another
routes.ex: There are two routes to the station.

see.en: to experience something, such as weather
see.ex: The north could see snow tonight.

settle.en: to stay over a place for some time
settle.ex: Fog will settle over the valley tonight.

short.en: falls short of: does not reach
short.ex: The result fell short of our target.

should.en: used to give advice or say what is likely

showers.ex: There will be showers this afternoon.

slide.en: to move down smoothly over a surface
slide.ex: Wet soil can slide down the hill.

slopes.en: surfaces that go up or down
slopes.ex: We skied down the steep slopes.

snow.en: soft white ice that falls from the sky
snow.ex: The children played in the snow.

snowfall.en: snow that falls; the amount of snow

so.en: to such a degree; even so = despite that
so.ex: It was so cold that we stayed home.
so.zh: 如此；（even so：儘管如此；so many：這麼多）

some.en: a number of, but not all
some.ex: Some parents may still hesitate to use the plan.

south.en: the direction towards the bottom of a map
south.ex: Many birds fly south in winter.

southern.ex: They live in a southern farming village.

spell.en: a short period of a type of weather
spell.ex: We had a long dry spell in summer.

stay.ex: Most tourists stay in the centre.

steep.en: very large and fast (of a rise or fall)
steep.ex: There was a steep drop in sales.

stronger.ex: The wind got stronger after dark.

sudden.ex: A sudden storm closed the roads.

example.en: Ticket sales surpassed all expectations this year.
example.zh: 今年的票房超出所有人的預期。

note.usage: surpass expectations/a record；比 exceed 更正式。

noteHi.exampleTr: इस साल टिकट बिक्री ने सभी उम्मीदों को पार कर लिया।

noteEs.exampleTr: La venta de entradas superó todas las expectativas este año.

noteJa.exampleTr: 今年のチケット販売はすべての予想を上回った。

noteKo.exampleTr: 올해 티켓 판매는 모든 예상을 뛰어넘었다.

noteEn.meaning: to be greater or better than something.

system.en: a set of computer programs that work together
system.ex: The new booking system is easy to use.

taiwan.en: an island country in East Asia

temperature.en: how hot or cold something is

temperatures.en: how hot or cold things are

there.ex: We lived there for five years.

this.en: the thing here or just said

three-hour.ex: We took a three-hour train ride.

told.ex: She told her boss about the problem.

top.en: to be higher than an amount
top.ex: Sales could top one million this year.

totals.en: the full amounts when added together
totals.ex: Rain totals were highest in the mountains.

trails.ex: Some trails are closed after the rain.

trip.ex: The trip to Galway takes two hours.

tuesday.ex: The meeting is on Tuesday morning.

turn.en: to change to a new state; turn on = start a machine
turn.ex: The weather will turn cold tomorrow.

typhoon.en: a very strong tropical storm in the western Pacific
typhoon.ex: The typhoon closed schools and offices.

under.en: under the arrangement: by the deal; under way: happening
under.ex: Under the deal, each side pays half.

unleash.en: to suddenly let a strong force happen
unleash.ex: The storm could unleash floods in the valley.

up.en: used in phrasal verbs like warm up and pick up
up.ex: It will warm up later today.

updates.en: new pieces of information about a situation
updates.ex: Listen to the radio for weather updates.

urged.en: strongly asked someone to do something
urged.ex: The doctor urged him to stop smoking.

using.ex: Using a map helped us find the hotel.

vigilant.ex: Stay vigilant when driving at night.

example.en: Police asked residents to remain vigilant.
example.zh: 警方呼籲居民保持警覺。

noteHi.exampleTr: पुलिस ने निवासियों से सतर्क रहने को कहा।

noteEs.exampleTr: La policía pidió a los vecinos que permanecieran alerta.

noteJa.exampleTr: 警察は住民に警戒を続けるよう呼びかけた。

noteKo.exampleTr: 경찰은 주민들에게 경계를 늦추지 말라고 당부했다.

warmer.ex: The sea is warmer in August.

warning.en: a notice that danger may come
warning.ex: The coastguard issued a gale warning.

watch.ex: Keep a watch on the children by the water.
watch.zh: 注意；監視（keep a close watch）

wear.en: to have clothes on your body

weather.ex: The weather in Ireland changes quickly.

weekend.ex: We went to the beach at the weekend.

well.ex: The price is well above what we can pay.

were.ex: The roads were busy this morning.

wet.en: covered in water or with much rain

which.en: used to add information about a thing

wind.ex: Ireland has strong wind along the coast.

window.ex: Rain may fall within a three-hour window.

wise.ex: It would be wise to leave early.

work.en: something made by an artist; also a job (work and classes = 上班上課)
work.ex: This painting is a work of art.

workplaces.ex: Many workplaces now allow remote work.

would.en: used for possible or future situations
would.ex: A new road would help the town.

wu.en: a family name; here Wu Der-rong, a Taiwanese meteorologist

yilan.en: Yilan, a county in north-east Taiwan

zones.en: areas with a special use or rule
zones.ex: The city has six parking zones.
